title: Weapons Detection System
oneLiner: Multi-camera, real-time weapon + posture analytics backend with rule-based alerting and evidence capture.
objective: Build a multi-camera video-analytics backend that runs batched weapon and posture inference on live streams, evaluates configurable alert rules, records evidence clips, and exposes a streaming API for a frontend dashboard. Also benchmark CNN vs Transformer detectors (YOLOv8-EfficientViT vs RT-DETR) and trackers (SSD-MobileNetV2 vs YOLOv8 with ByteTrack).
achievements: Modified YOLOv8 with a custom EfficientViT backbone - higher precision/recall at lower resource cost than RT-DETR.
Built a modular pipeline to benchmark model pairs and derive Precision/Recall/F1 across architectures.
Implemented multi-camera, batch-synchronized inference with per-camera capture threads and bounded frame queues.
Integrated a dual-model pipeline (weapon detector + pose estimator) with warm-up inference to preload weights.
Built a rule-driven alert engine using weapon/posture class sets and consecutive-frame thresholds from config.
Added evidence capture: buffered WebM clip recording and alert persistence in SQLite with structured event payloads.
Exposed a camera-service API over WebSockets with CORS for a live dashboard.
